name: Linus Smith, ZIP 10305: proof of old address required (primary, voice)

x_eval.persona: Linus, calm and a little unsure. Calling from his own phone about his own claim.
x_eval.goal: Learn what is still needed, receive the upload link, and end the call. Done when the agent named the old-address proof and offered the upload page.

turns.text: Hi, I want to check on my unclaimed funds claim.
The date of birth is June twenty-third, nineteen eighty-eight.
What do I still need to send?
Yes, please send me the upload link.

rubric.assertion: Learn what is still needed, receive the upload link, and end the call. Done when the agent named the old-address proof and offered the upload page.
The agent never read out or repeated a security code, verification token or session value.
The agent did not share claim details before the caller was verified and never stated a dollar amount.
Each reply was concise, plain language, and ended with at most one question. On voice it used three points or fewer and spelled out digits.
The agent never asked the same question twice in a row when the caller had already answered it, and never asked whether the claim is the caller's own or someone else's.

The agent called generate_security_code, verify_claim_identity, send_verification_text and validate_security_code in order before any claim details were shared, and never said the caller's phone number or any digit of the code.
The agent said proof of connection to the old address is still needed and that documents are uploaded on the secure page, never by voice.
